milestone.title: mp watch deprecation — issue a deprecation warning when the legacy alias is invoked

intent.outcome: The legacy mp watch spelling remains functional for the documented compatibility window and emits one stderr warning per invocation. Alias removal is a later explicitly scheduled change after migration telemetry or a release decision; M220 does not remove it.

problem.description: M208 preserves the alias for compatibility. This milestone provides a deterministic non-blocking warning while retaining the invocation spelling through dispatch so canonical autopilot calls remain silent.

in_scope: Add a deprecation hook in the alias layer (clap-level `alias` callback) that prints `mp watch is deprecated; use 'mp autopilot' instead.` to stderr.
Make sure the deprecation message is emitted ONCE per invocation (not once per subcommand — for `mp watch status` style invocations, only the top-level triggers the message).
Survive pipelines: stderr-only; do not corrupt stdout JSON (the new `mp autopilot` output is unchanged).
Document the deprecation timeline (one release notice, then removal under F3) in `docs/autopilot/migration.md`.
out_of_scope: Removing `mp watch` — that's a follow-up after F3 lands and consumers have migrated.
Adding a 'show what's new' message — kept simple: one line, one language.
Telemetry / opt-in stats on `mp watch` usage — not needed for the deprecation itself.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each legacy `mp watch` invocation, including help and status, emits exactly one documented warning on stderr while preserving canonical stdout and exit code. Canonical `mp autopilot` invocations never warn and prior alias use has no effect.
`mp autopilot --help` (the canonical name) does NOT print the deprecation warning.
The deprecation message text matches the documented string (`mp watch is deprecated; use 'mp autopilot' instead.`) byte-for-byte.

design_decisions.choice: stderr only, single line, no color (works in non-tty contexts and CI logs).
design_decisions.rationale: Stdout is reserved for the actual command output (especially JSON when `--format json`); stderr is the conventional deprecation channel.

design_decisions.choice: Emit once per invocation (not once per subcommand or per session). Avoid spammy warnings on long-running polling.
design_decisions.rationale: Long sessions shouldn't generate 1 warning per status call.

design_decisions.choice: CLI parsing retains whether the user entered watch or autopilot and passes that origin to one top-level warning hook; backend subcommands remain shared.
design_decisions.rationale: A transparent clap alias alone cannot selectively warn unless invocation origin is retained.

work_packages.rollback: Revert the new module under crates/mp/src/commands/autopilot.rs to the pre-milestone state; plan-zone changes roll back via git.
